craft_notes: Sthāyin: thinking service. Device: end-dash→comma (standing softens, hankering released). Rejected: 'bide' for 'stands' — killed: stands kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Methinks one foot already on kind release's causeway stands,
whose hankering holds: 'Śiva will I serve' — ev'n this.
l4.sanskrit_cite: manye nyastapadaḥ so 'pi kṣemye mokṣasya vartmani manorathaḥ sthito yasya seviṣye śivam ity ayam
